assembly: Extract only bash.exe, msys-2.0.dll, grep.exe, msys-pcre-1.dll, msys-intl-8.dll and msys-iconv-2.dll from PortableGit/usr/bin.
Verify every decompressed SHA-256 against manifest.json. No stripping, patching or recompilation is performed.
Compress each binary separately using gzip level 9 with mtime=0. Include both pinned BusyBox Unicode binaries under their architecture-specific asset names.
The immutable runtime id is bash-busybox- followed by the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over Python json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True).
At runtime create BusyBox applet hard links; sh.exe links to GNU bash.exe. GNU grep is a separate program.
Keep matching license notices and corresponding source directions. BusyBox complete source is included in this package.
